title: Consultation for Prescribing Number of Members for District Commission

content.scenario: The Central Government is establishing a District Commission under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 and needs to prescribe the number of members for the Commission. They are considering the composition of the Commission.
content.outcome: The Central Government must consult with the relevant authorities when prescribing the number of members for the District Commission, which shall consist of a President and not less than two and not more than such number of members as may be prescribed.

user_queries: What is the process for prescribing the number of members for the District Commission?
Who must the Central Government consult with?
What is the composition of the District Commission?
